book.name: Hibluu-to
book.title: Kaapiya la vu hil bel-ate sen lavand Hibluu-to

content: Yesu tu yate yêêv bop salivangin-ate keen vu baandoni
+ o 8:1 Hiblu 1:3; 3:1; 10:12; 12:2*Vakasin sen yiiy naanêêl-anjo ond nôôn nambe yate yêêv bop salivangin-atêênju la nando Anutu nama vasa having yi vu baandoni lung la.
Tombe tu yêêv bop salivangin-ate be nawiing kul hôôk Anutu-te dumb vaambuung vu baandoni. Dumb-anju va keen lôôt, omaahonôôn-ame lahaav ak namand e, malis, yik Omaaho Bop timu yoo haav.

Tombe kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato silate yêêv-aso pin ond silate kul nambe sil datung vanôôn osin davu kaasêêh vahivak anihees natu salivangin vu Anutu, om yik Yesu yoo hatung yite salivangin having nambêênju.

Nambe mando voon ond me-lohvu nambe naatu kul vaha salivangin-ate ti le, in voon-anjo kul vaha sen datung salivangin-ato dando lung la, be datung salivangin vaha vaha vu Anutu lohvu Mose-te tanasin nêêl-ato.

+ o 8:5 Kol 2:17; Hiblu 9:23; Eks 25:40*Tombe latu kul vaha salivangin-ate be dawiing kul hôôk Anutu-te dumb vu voon-anjo, ond davu taahu dumb vaambuung sen nando baandonii-to kanu. Lohvu vakasin sen Anutu vu kôôvu Mose hôôk busin sen Mose navu daav dumb sel-ato. Anutu nêêl nambe, “Goo naalum in gale samu va pin nohvu kanu sen sa taato vu hong vu kandu luu-to.”

+ o 8:6 2Ko 3:6; Hiblu 7:22; 9:15*Lemu Kalisi hako kul yêêv bop salivangin-atêênju ond savok kul vaha vaalu sen datung salivangin bôôy-ato silate kul la. In hako Anutu-te vakasin moos sen jôôy-ato be vu vu yiiy, ond vakasin-anjo nivasa lôôt savok vakasin ango munggin-ato la. Tombe yik vakasin moos-anjo nêêl Anutu-te nôôn anivasa lak yiiy, tombe manyinjo nivasa lôôt savok va sen nêêl ak yiiy munggin-ato la.
Naambe vakasin sen Anutu jôôy bôôy-ambe Mose kaavuu-to nôôn keen ond me-lohvu nambe vakasin moos ango dukanom ahembaan e, malis.
+ o 8:8-12 Jer 31:31-34*Lemu Anutu nêêl hil pin-ate va nipaya langaah nambe,

content.text: “Omaaho Bop nêêl nambe, ‘Busin ti le sale naanjôôy vakasin moos naah gaving hil Islel osin hil Yuda.

Tombe vakasin moos sen sa naanjôôy-anjo ond me-le naambe sen saanjôôy bôôy vu silate himbop-aso le, malis. In bôôy saanjôôy vakasin having sil hôôk busin sen saapuvu hôôk sil namand-ambe saanggiiy sil vu Ijip-ambe lalaa-to, le ma de sil-ame taamuyin sate vakasin sen saanjôôy-ato nivasa le, malis, ondeey sa haluuh damingg vu sil.’ Ke, yik Omaaho Bop nêêl nambêênja.

+ o 8:10 Hiblu 10:16*Tonde yik Omaaho Bop nêêl having nambe, ‘Busin-anjo jung na vêêl e, mem sale naanjôôy vakasin moos ango gaving hil Islel jesin naah. Vakasin moos-anjo nambe sale baasu sate tanasin dukana sil alondpayo, tonde sa kaavu nanjip hôôk sil alund, tonde mem sa naatu silate Anutu, de sil daatu sate hil.

Tombe mem omaahonôôn ti ti pin ond sil-ame le taahu silate hil osin sil-ame le taahu halindin-ambe daanêêl naambe, “Ham oo anjak Omaaho Bop ani.” Malis, in busin-anju sil pin pasiv-ande bop, sil lalak sa ningg lung laa-to.
+ o 8:12 Hiblu 10:17*Sil davu kalêêh tanasin, lemu sale sa kangg pasiv in sil, tonde sa kangg-ame le bu silate va nipaya jesin naah e.’ Ke, yik Omaaho Bop nêêl nambêênja.”

content: Om Anutu nêêl yite vakasin moos-anju tombe wiing-ambe vakasin bôôy-ato nimbôôy ak, om va pin sen nimbôôy ak-ambe navu maahôôl laa-to, ond ngaaho lak in navu na menama valok-ate.
